questions.stem: Two reference entries assign different interpretations to the same legacy numeric trouble code. What evidence is needed before choosing its meaning?

choices.text: Manufacturer, applicable vehicle system, model year and diagnostic test context
The most common meaning from an online list

questions.rationale: Legacy code formats and descriptions depend on vehicle and test applicability; a code number alone cannot establish a component failure.

questions.stem: A training vehicle reports an airflow-circuit DTC and hesitates under load. Which next action best tests competing hypotheses?

choices.text: Clear the DTC and declare a repair
Confirm applicability, inspect relevant wiring and intake conditions, and compare scan observations against reviewed service information

questions.rationale: A DTC indicates a monitored condition; additional tests and applicable technical evidence are needed before attributing the fault to one component.

sourceContext.purpose: general airflow DTC context; not proof of specific vehicle behavior

questions.stem: For a fictional 12 V ideal resistive load of 6 ohms, compute predicted current and power. No independent workshop measurement is supplied. Explain whether a measured discrepancy or manufacturer compliance can be concluded.
expectedEvidence: no measurement supplied; discrepancy not determined
questions.rationale: Theoretical predictions do not establish observed values or OEM compliance without applicable independent evidence.
